review_question: How accurately do Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assays identify acute human leptospirosis relative to each source-defined reference standard?

population.description: Patients with suspected acute human leptospirosis

comparator.description: Source-defined reference standard (MAT, IgM ELISA, culture, or their prespecified combination)

targets.comparison: Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assay versus the source-defined reference standard

timepoint_policy.rule: Capture every complete source-supported 2x2 table and retain its index-test and reference-standard timepoint. Do not collapse alternative reference-standard timepoints from the same cohort during extraction.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: One complete source-supported Patoc-antigen LFA 2x2 table per index-test/reference-standard timepoint.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract source-supported TP, FP, FN, and TN for a Patoc-antigen LFA and the study-defined reference standard. Recompute sensitivity and specificity from counts. Do not derive counts from percentages or use a review forest value.

output_contract.effect_unit: one source-supported diagnostic 2x2 test set, with explicit index-test and reference-standard timepoint

target_compatibility.reason: No existing seven-case v1 template has the same data contract.
